clue.text: Tireless handyman holds drink

indicators.note: the two words written together are said to hold the answer within their run of letters

parts.note: the end of the first word plus the start of the second

explanation.surface: A handyman who never tires keeps hold of his beer.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters straddle the gap: tireles-S HANDY-man.
explanation.definitionFit: A shandy is a British drink of beer mixed with lemonade.

clue.text: Letters from copper sounded so long

indicators.note: sounded means the letters are spoken out loud and heard as words

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper; its two letters are said by name

explanation.surface: Someone reads the letters from a policeman aloud and is told goodbye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' looks like a policeman but is the metal, whose symbol is Cu.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are casual ways of saying goodbye, an informal farewell.

clue.text: Most important aspect of characters in the Odyssey?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the essential part, the whole of something
second meaning: two letters of the Greek alphabet, the script Homer's epic is written in

explanation.surface: A question about what matters most in Homer's epic poem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters' suggests Odysseus and his crew, but it means written letters: the first and last of the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: The first and last letters stand for the beginning and end, hence the whole or the essence of something.

clue.text: Hopelessness of the French couple

parts.note: French for 'of the' before a plural
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: A French couple is in a state of hopelessness.
explanation.definitionFit: Despair is a direct synonym: the complete loss of hope.

clue.text: University grounds affected you and me

parts.note: camp means theatrically affected or exaggerated
you and me together are us

explanation.surface: Being at university has had an effect on the two of us.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Affected' reads as a verb, 'changed', but is the adjective meaning mannered.
explanation.definitionFit: A campus is the site and grounds of a university or college.

clue.text: A lot coming round for tea

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: coming round suggests turning about, so the word is read the other way

parts.note: a mass is a lot, a great quantity

explanation.surface: Many people are visiting for tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Assam is a strong black tea named after the Indian state where it grows.

clue.text: Delay start once pair taken ill

indicators.note: something taken ill is out of sorts, so these letters are put out of order

parts.note: the thirteen letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A twosome put off starting because both fell sick.
explanation.definitionFit: To procrastinate is to put off action, a synonym of delaying.

clue.text: Labour right involved in smear

indicators.note: involved in means placed inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a smear is a stain
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A Labour politician's right-wing leanings are caught up in a smear campaign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' looks like the British political party, but is the verb 'toil'.
explanation.definitionFit: To strain is to labour, to make a great effort.

clue.text: Partner no longer modelled on show

parts.note: a former partner is an ex
a model poses for an artist

explanation.surface: A former partner modelled at an exhibition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something exposed is on display, uncovered for all to see.

clue.text: Rebellious daughter insisted on breaking up

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter

indicators.note: breaking up means falling to pieces, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A defiant daughter demanded to split up with her boyfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissident opposes established authority; here it is used as an adjective, as in dissident groups.

clue.text: Sheeran's first disappointing track

indicators.note: first asks for only the opening letter of the singer's name

parts.note: the first letter of the name
a disappointing effort is poor

explanation.surface: Ed Sheeran's debut single was a letdown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Track' wants to be a song, but it is an animal's trail.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoor is the track or scent trail left by a wild animal.

clue.text: City in the States beginning to overtax millions I see

indicators.note: the beginning to a word is its opening letter alone

parts.note: the first letter of the word
M is the abbreviation for millions
aha is what you say when you see the point

explanation.surface: An American city has begun overtaxing its residents by millions, I gather.
explanation.definitionFit: Omaha is the largest city in Nebraska, in the United States.

clue.text: Clumsily I arm a US warrior

indicators.note: done clumsily means done awkwardly, so these letters fall into disorder

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone awkwardly equips an American soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A samurai was a member of the hereditary warrior class of feudal Japan.

clue.text: Youth who fancied himself a handsome sight in bed?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the beautiful young man of Greek myth who fell in love with his own reflection
second meaning: a flower such as the daffodil, attractive in a flower bed

explanation.surface: A vain young man thinks he looks good between the sheets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bed' suggests the bedroom, but it is a flower bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the self-loving youth of myth and to the genus of spring flowers including daffodils.

clue.text: Curse drunken rogues holding Charlie

indicators.note: holding means the rearranged letters wrap around another piece
drunken suggests staggering about, so these letters lurch into a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Drunken villains swear while hanging on to a man called Charlie.
explanation.definitionFit: A scourge is an affliction, a source of great suffering, much as a curse is.

clue.text: Draughtsman up for prize

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a draughtsman is someone who draws

explanation.surface: An artist is in the running for an award.
explanation.definitionFit: A reward is something given in return for achievement, a prize.

clue.text: Picked up voice note

indicators.note: picked up means caught by the ear, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a tenor is a high male singing voice

explanation.surface: A singer has caught a musical note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' suggests music beside 'voice', but it is a banknote: a tenner is British slang for a ten-pound note.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenner is a ten-pound or ten-dollar note, a piece of paper money.

clue.text: Controversial European cause

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for European
a motive is the cause of an action

explanation.surface: A political cause in Europe stirs up disagreement.
explanation.definitionFit: An emotive issue arouses strong feeling, so it tends to be controversial.

clue.text: Silly way ET begins?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: foolish, empty of sense

definitions.note: a cryptic phrase read as 'in an E'
definitions.meaning: second meaning, split into three words: the way ET begins is with the letter E at the start

explanation.surface: A question about how the alien film starts, dismissed as silly.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into IN AN E: ET begins in an E. The question mark flags this playful reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane means senseless or silly, lacking any meaningful content.

clue.text: Flipping nasty old woman

indicators.note: flipping means turning over, so the letters are read back to front

parts.note: something nasty is evil
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: A frustrated outburst about a horrible old lady.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flipping' reads as a mild British swear word, but it is the instruction to turn the letters round.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive is a woman's first name, a crossword-style definition by example.

clue.text: Neighbourhood welcoming new stadium

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a neighbourhood is a local area
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: Local residents welcome a new sports ground.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is an enclosed venue for sport or entertainment, much like a stadium.

clue.text: Entourage protecting queen in ground

indicators.note: protecting means surrounding, so one piece shields the other inside it

parts.note: a train is a retinue of followers
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen's cipher

explanation.surface: The royal entourage guards the queen in the grounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain is a stretch of land considered by its physical features, that is, ground.

clue.text: Merchant looking embarrassed about drinking beer

indicators.note: drinking means swallowing, so the letters take the other piece inside them
about means turned round, so the colour word is read backwards

parts.note: an embarrassed face looks red
ale is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: A trader blushes when caught drinking on the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A dealer is a trader who buys and sells goods, a merchant.

clue.text: Reportedly encounter Pooh's friend, a trailblazer?

indicators.note: reportedly means as said by others, so the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: to encounter is to meet; Eeyore is the gloomy donkey friend of Winnie-the-Pooh

explanation.surface: Someone reportedly meets one of Winnie-the-Pooh's companions, a pioneer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trailblazer' usually means a pioneer; the question mark flags the literal sense of something blazing across the sky leaving a trail.
explanation.definitionFit: A meteor is a shooting star, burning brightly and leaving a luminous trail behind it.
